channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Five Software Testing Challenges Local Tech Teams Can Overcome
item.description: Software testing is a cornerstone of delivering high-quality software, yet many local tech teams face persistent challenges that can slow development and compromise product quality.

item.title: Case Opening Site CaseHug: The Funniest Moments That Happen During Case Openings
item.description: Case openings in Counter-Strike are supposed to be about skins, probabilities, and the thrill of rare drops.

item.title: UPDATE: Warrant issued for man convicted of criminal sexual conduct with a minor
item.description: Miguel Angel Tovar Calderon, 51, failed to show for court after being convicted of five of six counts against him.

item.title: Man sentenced to nearly 2 years prison for August 2025 hit-and-run
item.description: 20-year-old Marcello Adan Canales gets 23 months in St. Cloud prison and must pay restitution for an Austin hit-and-run that badly injured a 65-year-old man and his dog.

item.title: Sharon E. Schleich
item.description: Sharon E. Schleich, age 81, of Winona, MN, and a former long-time resident of Owatonna, MN, passed away on Tuesday, March 10, 2026, at the Emplify Health Hospital in La Crosse, WI.

item.title: Winter storm watch issued ahead of the possibility for substantial snow fall
item.description: Winter storm watch from Saturday 7 p.m. to Monday 1 p.m., with 4–8 inches of snow possible, rain/snow mix and gusts to 41 mph, following a high wind warning with 60 mph gusts tonight.

item.title: How Military Experience Shapes Homeownership Decisions
item.description: The Office of the Texas Governor, Greg Abbott, reveals interesting demographics regarding veterans in the Lone Star State.

item.title: Rebels rejoice: Southland blows out Cardinals to earn first state berth in school history
item.description: Southland dominates Lewiston-Altura 87-60 for first boys basketball state berth, fueled by Henry Wiste’s 34 points and a decisive 22-0 run in the Section 1A title game.

item.title: Blue Devils fall short in national quarterfinals
item.description: Riverland CC’s 29-3 season ends with 67-64 loss to Dallas College Richland in NJCAA national quarterfinals; Tyson Helms scores 15 points and 4 assists for the Blue Devils.

item.title: Packer boys eliminated in Section 1AAA title game
item.description: Northfield tops Austin 60-51 in Section 1AAA title game, using second-half surge and late offensive boards to deny Packers their first state trip since 2022.
